title: Israel's Unfaithfulness and Punishment

questions.question: What are the people told to call their brothers and sisters?
options: My people and She has obtained mercy
questions.correctAnswer: My people and She has obtained mercy
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:1 (ESV): "Say to your brothers, 'You are my people,' and to your sisters, 'You have received mercy.'"

questions.question: Who is Hosea pleading with in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:2 (ESV): "Plead with your mother, plead--for she is not my wife,"

questions.question: What did the mother say she would go after?
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:5 (ESV): "For she said, 'I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water,'"

questions.question: Therefore I will hedge up her way with what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:6 (ESV): "Therefore I will hedge up her way with thorns,"

questions.question: And I will betroth you to me for how long?
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:19 (ESV): "And I will betroth you to me forever."

questions.question: What will God make the Valley of Achor into?
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:15 (ESV): "and make the Valley of Achor a door of hope."

questions.question: On that day, she will call Me "My Husband," and no longer call Me what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:16 (ESV): "you will call me 'My Husband,' and no longer will you call me 'My Baal.'"

questions.question: God will make a covenant for them on that day with whom?
options: The beasts of the field, the birds of the heavens, and the creeping things
questions.correctAnswer: The beasts of the field, the birds of the heavens, and the creeping things
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:18 (ESV): "And I will make for them a covenant on that day with the beasts of the field, the birds of the heavens, and the creeping things of the ground."

questions.question: I will betroth you to me in righteousness and in justice, in steadfast love and in what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:19 (ESV): "in steadfast love and in mercy."

questions.question: And I will have mercy on No Mercy, and I will say to Not My People...?
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:23 (ESV): "and I will say to Not My People, 'You are my people'"

questions.question: She did not know that it was I who gave her what?
options: The grain, the wine, and the oil
questions.correctAnswer: The grain, the wine, and the oil
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:8 (ESV): "And she did not know that it was I who gave her the grain, the wine, and the oil,"

questions.question: I will put an end to all her mirth, her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her...?
I will punish her for the feast days of whom?
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:13 (ESV): "And I will punish her for the feast days of the Baals"

questions.question: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak how to her?
And the earth shall answer the grain, the wine, and the oil, and they shall answer whom?

key_verse_text: And I will betroth you to me forever. I will betroth you to me in righteousness and in justice, in steadfast love and in mercy. I will betroth you to me in faithfulness. And you shall know the Lord.
